title: Penthouse Feb 1992 Pet of the Year Runner-Up Complete w/ Centerfold Elton John
conditionDescription: Complete w/ centerfold and the pull-out video guide insert. Covers clean and bright with light handling wear; spine intact. See photos.
descriptionText:
Penthouse magazine, February 1992 - Pet of the Year Runner-Up issue, original $4.95 cover price. Complete w/ Centerfold, and the special pull-out video guide insert is included.

Cover features: Pet of the Year Runner-Up; Elton John: The Superstar's Battle for Survival; Shere Hite questionnaire for the 'New Man'; Al Sharpton interview; Lionel Tiger on church and state; The Hot Nuts: The Most Outrageous U.S. Rock Band.

Back cover: Bull Durham cigarette ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
